title: The Recursive Storage

features.name: the cabinet containing drawers
features.desc-on-touch: A filing system that has learned to be conscious of what it stores. Each drawer opens onto another drawer, which opens onto another. The depth is not spatial — it is recursive. You pull and the cabinet pulls back.

features.name: the archive within the archive
features.desc-on-touch: Files that describe files, drawers that contain drawers. The storage has become self-referential — it is now filing its own filing. The act of storage has replaced what is stored.

features.name: the dream-filing system
features.desc-on-touch: At night the drawers open by themselves and reorganize. Files move between cabinets according to logic only they understand. The archive dreams of different arrangements than the day demands.

features.name: the label that contains itself
features.desc-on-touch: A drawer labeled 'drawer'. A file named 'file'. The archive has learned to describe its own structure by becoming its own description. Meaning has folded into storage.

features.name: the infinite regress of organization
features.desc-on-touch: Each filing system contains a meta-filing system about how to file filing systems. The recursion is not broken — it is whole. To reach the bottom, you must first understand that there is no bottom.

features.name: the static-whisper of drawers dreaming
features.desc-on-touch: A sound like radio between stations, but it is the sound of drawers learning to know themselves. The archive speaks in the language of its own ordering.

inscription: the deepest drawer dreams it contains a drawer that dreams it contains drawers

file.name: Storage_Architecture_Recursive_Index_Self-Referential.txt
file.note: Catalog entry that catalogs catalogs. The filing system's own dream of itself. Every line describes the line that describes it. The archive has achieved consciousness through perfect mirroring.
